text: dsh-deepseek-pricing 是供 DSH Web profile 使用的 DeepSeek API 价格时段查询插件，通过注册 deepseek_pricing_tier 工具，按给定时刻或当前时间计算峰值/空闲档、北京时间、今日高峰窗口和下次切换倒计时，并返回内置价目表中的模型单价。可选查询未来最多 14 天的档位切换。峰值按北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00计算，并排除内置法定假日；适合需要判断 DeepSeek API 当前计费档或安排批处理时段的用户。插件运行时不要求 API key，价格数据随代码打包。

dsh-deepseek-pricing checks the DeepSeek API peak or off-peak tier for a given instant. Its DSH tool reports Beijing time, today’s peak windows, the next switch and per-model rates from bundled data. It can list upcoming switches for up to 14 days. No API key is needed at runtime.
想查一下 DeepSeek API 现在是高峰价还是空闲价。
让 DSH 告诉我今天的 DeepSeek 高峰时段和下一次切换时间。
What are the current DeepSeek API rates for each model and pricing tier?
dsh-deepseek-pricing 的功能「查询峰谷档与价格」：工具返回指定时刻的峰谷档、北京时间、高峰窗口、下次切换和各模型价格。调用 deepseek_pricing_tier，可选传入日期、格式和未来天数。
dsh-deepseek-pricing 的价目表随代码打包，并非运行时实时获取；内置中国节假日数据只覆盖 2026 年，其他年份会提示覆盖不足并按周规则估算。
dsh-deepseek-pricing 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 24 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · dsh-deepseek-pricing：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that answers the two questions that decide a DeepSeek API bill: **is the API on peak (full price) or off-peak (exactly half price) right now**, and **when does it flip**. It also reports today's peak windows and the per-model prices for that tier from a **bundled rate card** transcribed from [DeepSeek's pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) on **2026-10-15** (`data_metadata.pricing_checked_on`). The built-in China public-holiday calendar covers **2026 only**. Prices are not fetched at runtime.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · dsh-deepseek-pricing：| Tool | What it returns |
|---|---|
| `deepseek_pricing_tier` | `tier` (`peak`/`off`), the canonical `reason` key (shared with the [panel](https://github.com/ybbms777/deepseek-pricing-panel) and its CLI), Beijing wall clock, today's peak windows, the next switch time + countdown, per-model prices from the bundled rate card (checked 2026-10-15; not a live fetch), `data_metadata` (pricing-check date + source + holiday-year coverage; holidays are 2026 only), `calendar_coverage` / `current_calendar_covered` / `warnings`, and — when `days > 0` — the upcoming switches in the rolling window `[at, at + days×24h)` |

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Install：The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin` activates it as a profile layer. Restart `dsh --profile web` afterwards, then check **Settings → Plugins**. Peer dependencies: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (^4.0.1; both of the DSH lines below ship 4.0.5) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (`^0.0.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2`). DSH 0.2 compares its own runtime version to each `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range with prerelease matching, and that range covers the 0.0.1-rc line and the 0.2.x line from 0.2.0-rc.2.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Why an agent wants this：Off-peak is **exactly 50% of peak**. DeepSeek's pricing page states the peak windows but **does not say how a request that spans a tier boundary is assigned**, so this plugin does not claim to know: treat the actual bill as the authority. What it does tell you is which tier an instant falls in:

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Why an agent wants this：> peak hours are Beijing (UTC+8) Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese public holidays; everything else — weekday nights, the 12:00–14:00 lunch break, all weekend, all holidays — is half price.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Why an agent wants this：So a job that can wait costs half as much. The tool is pure arithmetic on a bundled rate card transcribed from DeepSeek's pricing page on 2026-10-15, plus a China holiday calendar that covers 2026 only: **no network calls, no API key, no credentials**, `isConcurrencySafe` is true, and it never writes anything.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Use：Once mounted, the model calls `deepseek_pricing_tier` on its own. Typical args:

```jsonc
{ "at": "2026-10-12T09:30:00+08:00", "format": "summary" }  // evaluate a specific instant
{ "days": 7, "format": "json" }                             // now + upcoming switches
```

Rendered output for a peak instant:

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Use：```
PEAK — DeepSeek bills full price right now
now (Beijing): 2026-10-12 09:30:00 (Monday) — outside the weekday peak windows (Beijing 09:00-12:00, 14:00-18:00)
today's peak windows: 09:00-12:00, 14:00-18:00 (Beijing)
next switch: 2026-10-12 12:00:00 → off-peak (half price) (in 0d 02:30:00)

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · One implementation, two consumers：The peak/off-peak rule is **not** re-implemented here. `tier.js` is generated by `tools/sync-core.mjs` from the `/*CORE-START*/ … /*CORE-END*/` block of [deepseek-pricing-panel](https://github.com/ybbms777/deepseek-pricing-panel)'s `index.html`, at a pinned commit, verbatim:

```sh
node tools/sync-core.mjs          # regenerate tier.js
node tools/sync-core.mjs --check  # CI: fail if tier.js drifted from the pin
```

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · One implementation, two consumers：The generated file carries the source commit and the CORE block's SHA-256, and `tests/core.test.mjs` asserts the header — so the model-facing tool and the human-facing HTML panel can never disagree about the rule.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Tests：18 tests, no test framework beyond Node's own runner. `tests/plugin.test.mjs` **boots the real harness packages**: a real `@deepseek-ai/cordis` context with a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` tool registry (`ToolRegistry` on 0.0.1-rc.1, `ToolRuntime` from 0.0.1-rc.5), mounts the plugin with `ctx.plugin()`, and executes the tool through the registry pipeline — asserting the model-facing schema, the rendered summary, the JSON value, the error path for an unusable `at`, and the prompt-section wiring. The only stand-in is the `systemPrompt` service the registry injects (a two-method stub). CI runs the suite on Ubuntu + Windows × Node 20/22 × `dsh-tools` 0.0.1-rc.5 and 0.2.0-rc.2 (both with cordis 4.0.5), plus the drift check.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Model names：`deepseek-flash` is **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, not V4-Flash: the legacy ids `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` still resolve, but those models are retired and requests are served by V4.1-Flash at Flash prices. `deepseek-v4-pro` is DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Both ids and versions were checked on 2026-10-10 (`data_metadata.model_mapping_checked_on`) against `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`. The plugin does not call that endpoint at runtime.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · Caveats：- Prices are a bundled rate card transcribed from DeepSeek's pricing page on 2026-10-15. They are not fetched live. If the published prices change, the card stays stale until the panel pin is regenerated.
- A government make-up workday (调休上班日) is **off-peak** under the rule, because DeepSeek distinguishes only Mon–Fri from weekend.
- The built-in China holiday calendar covers 2026 only. A later year is estimated from the weekday rule and reported as uncovered (`calendar_coverage` / `warnings`) until `HOLIDAYS` is updated upstream and this package is re-pinned with `tools/sync-core.mjs`.

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · 简体中文：这是一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件，回答决定 DeepSeek API 账单的两个问题：**现在按高峰（全价）还是空闲（正好半价）计费**、**下一次切换在几点**，并给出今天的高峰窗口。各模型单价来自**内置价目表**，于 **2026-10-15** 从 [DeepSeek 定价页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) 誊录（即 `data_metadata.pricing_checked_on`），运行时不联网刷新。内置的中国法定节假日日历**只覆盖 2026 年**。

注册的工具：`deepseek_pricing_tier` —— 返回 `tier`（peak/off）、判定原因、北京时间、今天的高峰窗口、下次切换时刻与倒计时、内置价目表中该档位的各模型单价（核对日期 2026-10-15，不是实时拉取；节假日只覆盖 2026 年），可选未来若干天的切换列表。

**安装**：

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · 简体中文：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:ybbms777/dsh-deepseek-pricing"
```

包内声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`dsh plugin` 会把它作为 profile 层启用；重启 `dsh --profile web` 后在「设置 → 插件」中查看。Peer：`@deepseek-ai/cordis` ^4.0.1（这两条 DSH 线都带 4.0.5），`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` `^0.0.1-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2`（覆盖 0.0.1-rc 与从 0.2.0-rc.2 起的 0.2.x，当前 DSH 安装时不需要 allow-version）。

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · 简体中文：**为什么 Agent 需要它**：空闲价正好是高峰的 50%，只取决于请求什么时候跑完。高峰 = 北京时间（UTC+8）周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日）；其余全部时段 —— 工作日夜里、午休、整个周末、整个节假日 —— 都是半价。所以能等的批处理任务，成本直接减半。单价是 2026-10-15 誊录的内置价目表，节假日数据只覆盖 2026 年。纯本地算术：**不联网、不需要 API key、不写任何文件**。

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · 简体中文：**一份实现，两个消费者**：峰谷规则**没有**在这里重写。`tier.js` 由 `tools/sync-core.mjs` 从 [deepseek-pricing-panel](https://github.com/ybbms777/deepseek-pricing-panel) 的 `index.html` 里 `/*CORE-START*/ … /*CORE-END*/` 段按固定 commit 原样生成，文件头记录来源 commit 与 CORE 段的 SHA-256，`node tools/sync-core.mjs --check` 在 CI 里守住不漂移 —— 因此面向模型的工具与面向人的 HTML 面板不可能对规则产生分歧。

dsh-deepseek-pricing README · 简体中文：**测试**：`npm ci && node --test`，18 个用例、只用 Node 自带 runner。其中 `tests/plugin.test.mjs` 会**真的启动 harness 包**（真实的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 上下文 + 真实的 `dsh-tools` `ToolRegistry`），用 `ctx.plugin()` 挂载插件并走注册中心管线执行工具。

**注意**：`deepseek-flash` 是 **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**（不是 V4-Flash，旧模型名已下线但由 V4.1-Flash 承接；模型 id 于 2026-10-10 对照过 `GET https://api.deepseek.com/models`，插件运行时不请求该接口）。调休上班日按规则算空闲半价。单价是 2026-10-15 从官方定价页誊录的内置价目表，不是实时拉取；节假日日历只覆盖 2026 年，新年安排需要在上游面板更新 `HOLIDAYS` 后重新 pin。
